scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tubepilot/api && concurrently --kill-others --names API,APP "npm run serve -w @tubepilot/api" "npm run dev -w @tubepilot/mobile"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tubepilot/ai-gateway && npm run build -w @tubepilot/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tubepilot/api && npm run build -w @tubepilot/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
